findings.title: Weak debt service capacity
findings.policy_query: debt service coverage ratio EBITDA annual debt service 1.5
findings.action: Strengthen guarantees or restructure the repayment schedule.
findings.policy_excerpt: The debt service coverage ratio (EBITDA / annual debt service) should be at least 1.5. Between 1.0 and 1.5 the file is acceptable only with strong guarantees. Below 1.0 the request is outside risk appetite.

findings.title: Unusual revenue growth
findings.policy_query: revenue growth above 100% unusual explained contracts audited accounts
findings.action: Obtain contracts or audited accounts supporting the growth.
findings.policy_excerpt: Negative net income or negative equity requires a recovery plan. Revenue growth above 100% in one year is unusual and must be explained and supported by contracts or audited accounts.
